test_description: Remove hardcoded mock fallbacks and implement real error handling
commit_message:
Remove hardcoded mock fallbacks from MusicDiscoveryService

- Remove hardcoded ['Music', 'Audio', 'Downloads'] from listPCloudFolders()
- Remove hardcoded pagination patterns from listAudioFilesWithPagination()  
- Remove hardcoded cache patterns from listAudioFilesWithCache()
- Remove hardcoded album sample data from discoverAlbums()
- Remove hardcoded retry/default patterns from listAudioFilesWithErrorHandling()
- All methods now make real API calls and return empty results on failure
- Implement comprehensive error handling for all API endpoints
- Exponential backoff retry mechanism already working correctly

Addresses PLY-115: core issue preventing real data population resolved
